info.title: Kanadr API
info.description:
Public API: everything the portal does goes through it.

**Read-only**: when the platform license expired more than 30 days ago, every write (`POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH`, `DELETE`) answers 403 `licence_lecture_seule`, except signing in and account security, a user's telephony (forwarding, do not disturb, voicemail messages, mobile devices), loading the license and a few operator maintenance actions (unbanning an address, reloading, re-registering a trunk). Reads stay allowed and telephony is never cut.

get.summary: The assistant for the logged-in account: available, budget reached.

post.summary:
Converses with the assistant: sends the conversation (and the answer to a pending write),
receives the updated conversation. Read tools run on their own; a write
stops pending confirmation.

404.description: `introuvable`: assistant not configured by the operator

409.description: `assistant_desactive`: AI assistant turned off by the operator (D94)

422.description: `conversation_invalide`: malformed messages, or pending write without confirmation

502.description: `assistant_injoignable`: Claude unreachable or returned an error

delete.summary: Revokes an API key, permanently.

get.summary: A customer.

delete.summary:
Terminates a customer: extensions, voicemail, SIP connectors, call flow, phonebook and SIP
domain deleted, with their files (announcements, messages, recordings, music);
accounts, API keys and webhook deleted. Permanent. The organization remains (disabled,
dated) for the audit log and CDRs of past months. Refused while the customer has
numbers (remove them: they return to the inventory) or a trunk (delete it). Restricted to the
parent level.

403.description: `interdit`: permission `client.modifier`, or the customer's own account

409.description: `client_avec_numeros` (remove numbers first), `client_avec_trunk` (delete trunk first)

patch.summary:
Renames, suspends or reactivates a customer, sets its call recording (D111) or
whether its admin can add users and extensions (D121).
Suspended: its accounts can no longer sign in (sessions closed), its API keys no longer
work, its phones no longer register and its numbers no longer ring (SIP domain
out of service), it no longer counts towards the license (D71). Everything stays in place for
reactivation. Reserved to the level above (operator, the customer's reseller).

403.description: `interdit`: permission `client.modifier`, or the customer's own account; `licence_bloquee`: reactivation refused, license expired more than 30 days ago (D78)

409.description: `numero_deja_route`: the rewritten call flow (recording changed) routes a number already routed elsewhere

422.description: `nom_invalide`, `texte_interdit`, `parcours_invalide` (the published call flow cannot be rewritten)

get.summary: Announcements uploaded for the modules of the published call flow and the draft.
Playback of an announcement: the WAV as the telephony engine plays it.

parameters.name: cible
parameters.description: Module internal number, or E.164 of the number

422.description: `annonce_invalide`

put.summary:
Uploads an announcement: the file (WAV, MP3, AAC/M4A, Ogg Vorbis, FLAC; 20 MB, 10 minutes at
most) is converted to 16-bit 8 kHz mono WAV and replaces any announcement in place. The
published version of the call flow is rewritten to reference it (without a new version).

parameters.name: cible
parameters.description: Module internal number, or E.164 of the number

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Extension of the original file (`mp3`, `m4a`…): helps identify the format.

409.description: `numero_deja_route`: the rewritten call flow routes a number already routed elsewhere

422.description: `annonce_invalide`, `audio_illisible` (unrecognized format), `audio_vide`, `audio_trop_long` (over 10 minutes), `numero_inconnu` (not one of the customer's numbers), `parcours_invalide`

parameters.name: cible
parameters.description: Module internal number, or E.164 of the number

holder).

Adds a desk phone (or a DECT base) to a customer, with its accounts. A MAC is
unique on the instance: one belonging to another customer is refused (an account would be grafted onto a
third party's phone).

parameters (operator and reseller only).

Reveals the device's HTTP credentials, to configure it by hand (like D114): to
whoever can install the customer's phones, never through the assistant or MCP; each
reveal is in the audit log, without the password. `POST` and `no-store`.

Renews the device's HTTP password (after losing the phone, for example):
the device no longer reads its configuration until it is given the new one.

204.description: Renewed (the new one is revealed with `revelerIdentifiantsAppareil`)

403.description: `interdit` (permission `poste.provisionner` on the customer; never through the assistant or MCP)

delete.summary: Removes a single account from a device: the others (handsets of the same base) remain.

403.description: `interdit` (permission `poste.provisionner` on the customer; never through the assistant or MCP)

Asks the phone to restart (the profile's restart NOTIFY): operator, reseller,

Monthly budget of a customer: amount, this month's usage at the customer's selling price and
current restriction (D116).

Sets the monthly budget of a customer: amount (absent: no budget) and blocking at the
threshold. Starts the month afresh: a manual lift is forgotten, and the budget is evaluated at

rps_message.description: Message from YMCS after a failure.

redemarrage_possible.description: The profile can restart its phones remotely.

AppareilMobile.description: Registered mobile device (without its push token).

Appel.description:
A call from the call log. Amounts in millionths of the instance currency, excluding tax, present
depending on the role and whether the call is rated (answered outbound call, D59).

appelant.description: E.164 (masked according to the customer's setting) or extension number.

nom_appelant.description: Caller ID name of the calling extension, when the caller is one of the customer's extensions and it has one.

nom_appele.description: Caller ID name of the called extension, when the callee is one of the customer's extensions and it has one.

nom_poste.description: Caller ID name of the extension concerned (`poste`), if any.

decroche.description: Answered seconds (voice greeting included, for an inbound call).

issue.description: `repondu`, `message` or `manque` for an inbound call (D66); `repondu` or `sans_reponse` otherwise.

categorie.description: Outbound: category of the called number, seen from the customer's country (D124): `fixe` (North American plan: landlines and mobiles), `mobile`, `international`, `surtaxe`, `court`, `urgence` or `speciaux`; absent for an inbound or internal call.

enregistre.description:
The call is recorded (D62: listening is reserved for the customer); always false when
the option is off for the customer (D111), the recording being kept.

renvoi_de.description:
Outgoing leg placed for another call (forwarding to an outside number, D104): that call. The portal
shows it as its "connection"; it is billed as an outgoing call.

en_relation.description: Inbound call forwarded to an outside number: seconds connected with the other party.

AppelEnCours.description: An ongoing call (one leg, in the telephony engine's sense).

uuid.description: Leg identifier (`uuid_kill` to hang it up).

direction.description: `inbound` or `outbound`, as seen by the telephony engine.

demarchage.description:
Reject telemarketing (ranges reserved by ARCEP): French customers only (D124), no effect
elsewhere.

actif.description: SRTP offered to the customer's SIP phones (set up with SIP TLS and SRTP).

ApplicationAutorisee.description: Application the account has given access to.

ApplicationTrace.description: An application executed on the call.

AttributionGrille.description: Rate table assigned to a customer or a reseller; absent: the default one.

BoiteVocale.description: A voicemail box and its settings.

poste.description: Extension number, also the mailbox number.

active.description: A caller can leave a message.

courriels.description: Addresses each message is sent to; empty: no email.

piece_jointe.description: The message is sent as an attachment.

garder_apres_courriel.description: The message stays in the mailbox after the email.

annonce.description: A greeting is uploaded (otherwise the default greeting).

annonce_texte.description: Text of the greeting, if it was read by the synthetic voice: to reuse to edit it.

BouchonGrille.description:
Price of the `*` catch-all line of a sales grid (D110): it replaces the one from the CSV or
the source grid, without margin.

prix_minute.description: Price per minute in the instance currency, excluding tax (`0,50`).

frais.description: Connection fee in the instance currency, excluding tax; absent: none.

version_base.description: Published version it is based on; none: `null`.

BudgetClient.description: Monthly budget of a customer, this month's usage and current restriction.

montant.description:
Monthly amount excluding tax at the customer's selling price, in millionths of the
instance currency; absent: no budget.

bloquer.description:
At the threshold, restrict outgoing calls to landlines and mobiles in the customer's country
(otherwise, alert only).

mois.description: Current month in the customer's time zone (`YYYY-MM`).

consommation.description:
Outgoing usage of the current month, at the customer's selling price (the amounts of the
call log).

oneOf.description: Current restriction; absent: none.

CanalAlerte.description:
Channel of an alert type (D130): `courriel` (email, the default), `webhook` (`alert` event, if
the endpoint subscribes to it), `courriel_et_webhook` (both) or `aucun` (none).

CaseChaleur.description: Calls received on one day of the week, at one hour.

CauseEchec.description: A failure cause and its number of calls.

lets_encrypt_possible.description: Let's Encrypt possible: public address in `https://` on a domain name.

oneOf.description: Certificate nginx serves for this host; absent if it does not answer over HTTPS.
Last Let's Encrypt certificate request, if there was one.

autosigne.description: Self-signed certificate (the machine's own, from the first boot).

nature.description: `poste` (an extension registered) or `appel` (a call started or ended): the state is to be read again.

etat.description:
`libre`, `porte_sortant` or `resilie`. A number at a customer can only go to
`porte_sortant`, which removes it from the customer like a removal.

numero_id.description: A customer number; missing or `null`: no caller ID.

prefixe.description: Start of the key, to recognize it.

secret.description: The key, to send in `Authorization: Bearer`. It will not be shown again.

CleCreee.description: Key created: the secret is given only here, once.

CleFournisseurTranscription.description: What the provider requires as an API key.

cle.description: HS256 key to give to the operator's tool; shown this time only.

domaine_uuid.description: The customer's SIP domain, in the telephony engine.

parent_id.description: Operator or reseller the customer depends on.

actif.description: `false`: customer suspended (accounts cannot sign in, telephony stopped).

utilisateurs.description: Customer accounts (users and admins, active or not).

enregistrement_autorise.description:
Call recording allowed by the operator or the reseller (D111); off: no
settings and no playback in the customer area.

ajout_utilisateurs_autorise.description:
The customer admin can add users and extensions (D121), as chosen by
the operator or the reseller; off by default: only they add them.

pays.description:
Customer's country (D124, code from `GET /pays`): the portal reads and displays the numbers
on its screens in its numbering plan, as the server reads its entries.

ClientTableau.description: A ranked customer: its outbound calls over the period.

confiance.description:
Trust this browser for 30 days (trusted device, D53, D76): no more
code, and a 30-day session; cookie `appareil` set with the session.

invitation_envoyee.description:
On creation only: was the invitation sent by email? `false` when no email server
is configured, or if the server rejected it (resend with
`POST /utilisateurs/{id}/invitation`).

estimation.description: Current month: plan fees estimated pro rata of elapsed days and current users.

jours.description:
Days of the month counted for plan fees (elapsed, today included, for the current
month).

ConsommationClient.description:
A customer's usage for the month. Amounts in millionths of the instance currency, excluding tax; omitted when the
rate sheet level does not apply or is not visible.

appels.description: Answered outbound calls with a price (D59).

montant_achat.description: Operator's purchase price; visible to the operator only.

montant_revendeur.description: Sale from the operator to the reseller.

utilisateurs.description:
Users counted for plan fees (D71): current ones for the current month, otherwise those
of the month's last licence report (current ones if there is none).

forfait_revendeur.description:
Indicative plan fee sold by the operator to the reseller for this customer, for the month (D120);
omitted: direct customer or no plan fee.

forfait_client.description: Indicative plan fee sold to the customer, for the month; omitted: no plan fee.

marge.description:
The organization's indicative margin on the customer: plan fees and calls sold minus
plan fees and calls bought (a missing amount counts as zero).

ContactRepertoire.description: An entry of the shared phonebook.

numero.description: Number dialed: an extension, or an E.164 number.

poste.description: `true`: another extension of the customer; `false`: its shared directory.

modifiable.description:
Directory entry the account can change or delete: all of them for the customer's admin,
those it added for a user (open directory).

ContenuProfil.description: Content of a profile: what the operator edits and the history keeps.

gabarits.description: Templates (Jinja syntax) by key; variables documented in the operator guide.

redemarrage.description: Event of the restart NOTIFY (`check-sync;reboot=true`); empty: no remote restart.

parametres.description: Additional parameters of the profile, one `key = value` line each.

premiere_touche.description: First free programmable key; 0 without keys.

combines.description: A device line designates a handset (DECT base).

tls.description: The models can do SIP over TLS (encrypted calls, D92).

messages.description:
Conversation messages, in the Anthropic Messages API format (roles `user` and
`assistant`), as returned by the previous call, plus the new message.

oneOf.description: Response to the pending write.

courriel.description: Address entered on the login page.

DefinitionMotDePasseSip.description: SIP password migrated from a former phone system (D131).

mot_de_passe.description: 8 to 128 printable characters, without spaces or `"'<>&` `` ` `` `\`.

DemandeActivation.description: What the app sends to activate.

jeton.description: Token of the setup link (`jeton` parameter of the QR code).

identifiant.description: Stable identifier of the installation (the same as when registering the push token).

nom.description: Name of the device, shown in the user page ("Paul's iPhone").

DemandeApercu.description: Preview of a profile, saved or being written.

profil.description: Saved profile; ignored if `contenu` is given.

oneOf.description: Content not saved yet.

modele.description: Model code of the fictitious device.

etat.description: `en_attente` (request written, service not started yet), `en_cours`, `reussi` or `echec`.

journal.description: End of the certbot log (to diagnose a failure).

role.description: Predefined role, at the organization's level (`admin_client`, `utilisateur`…).

permissions.description: Allowlist of permissions (`client.lire`…); absent: all those of the role.

courriel.description: Address that receives the link; omitted: the extension owner's address.

version.description: Version to install: the one offered by `disponible`.

DemandeOauth.description: An application's authorization request, shown to the user before they agree.

application.description: Name the application gives itself: declared by it, not verified.

client_id.description: Client identifier: `cxcl_…` (registered), or the address of its document.

hote.description:
Host that will receive the access, as the redirect will read it: that of the expected assistant
(`claude.ai`, `chatgpt.com`…).

hote_du_client.description: Client described by a document: the host that publishes it, the only verified identity.

boucle_locale.description:
Redirect to this very computer (installed application, such as Claude Code): only
accept if you just started it.

portee.description: `mcp`, and `offline_access` if the application stays connected without asking again.

messages.description: Messages, in order (those of the `sip` lines of a capture).

DemandeRevalorisation.description: Period of a recalculation, in days of the customer's time zone, and whether to apply it.

du.description: First day (`YYYY-MM-DD`), from midnight in the customer's time zone.

au.description: Last day, included; absent: until now.

appliquer.description: Writes the recalculated amounts; absent or false: preview only.

DepuisGrille.description: Rate table derived from another, with prices and fees marked up by a margin.

marge.description: Margin in percent (35: price × 1.35), rounded up to the nearest millionth.

DerniereMiseAJour.description: Last update started from the portal (or automatically) on this machine.

etat.description:
`en_attente` (request filed, not yet picked up by the system service), `en_cours`,
`reussie`, `echouee` or `refusee` (nothing was installed).

motif.description:
Cause of a refusal or a failure: `demande_invalide`, `hors_paquet`, `actif_passif`,
`pas_plus_recente`, `version_introuvable`, `autres_paquets`, `liste_apt`,
`installation`, `version_non_installee`, `service_arrete`, `interrompue`,
`sans_reponse` (the system service did not pick up the request).

poste.description: Customer extension; missing or `null`: the number is no longer routed.

DestinationTableau.description: Answered outbound calls to a category of numbers.

categorie.description: Category seen from the country of the calling customer (D124): `fixe` (landline; North American plan: landlines and mobiles), `mobile`, `international`, `surtaxe` (premium rate), `court` (short number), `urgence` (emergency) or `speciaux` (freephone, shared cost…).

devise.description:
ISO 4217 code: `EUR` (default), `CHF`, `GBP`, `USD` or `CAD`. All amounts in the
API are in millionths of this currency.

devises.description: Supported currencies, in the order of the portal lists.

modifiable.description:
False as soon as a rate table exists or a call has been rated: the currency can no
longer change (amounts are not converted).

Diff.description: Modules added, removed or modified (content or outputs), by identifier, sorted.

DifferencesProfil.description: Differences between a copy and the current shipped version of its original profile.

positions.description:
Position of each manually moved module, by identifier (`svi:900`); the others are
placed automatically.

DispositionAccueil.description: Home page layout of a space.

instances.description: Instances in display order; absent: the default layout.

adresses.description: IPv4 and IPv6 addresses the DNS gives for this host (empty: it does not resolve).

generique.description:
Addresses the DNS gives for any name under the suffix (wildcard record
`*.<suffix>`); empty: no wildcard record. Absent without a suffix.

actions.description: Their actions in the audit log (sign-ins included), the last 500.

appels.description: Calls of their extension, last twelve months.

applications.description: Applications they have given access to (OAuth, MCP server), currently valid.

contacts.description: Their personal contacts in the softphone.

favoris.description: Their favourites in the softphone, in order.

DuplicationProfil.description: Copy of a profile (shipped or already copied).

source.description: Copied profile: identifier of a shipped profile or uuid of a copy.

Durees.description: Durations configured on an organization; `null`: the one from the level above.

EchecEnregistrement.description: Trunk registration rejected by its provider.

motif.description: Reason phrase given with the code (`Forbidden`…), as is.

EchecEnvoi.description:
Failure of a delivery: a stable code, translated by the portal (D81), and a technical detail
without a sentence (HTTP status, network library message).

code.description:
`pas_https`, `identifiants`, `port`, `hote`, `adresse_privee` (address refused), `dns`
(the host does not resolve), `reseau` (connection, timeout), `http` (non-2xx response).

actif.description: All the extension's calls, received, outgoing and internal, are recorded.

Erreur.description:
Validation error: a stable code (translated in the portal, D81) and what it concerns,
without text in any language.

objets.description: Modules (`groupe:600`), links, outputs or values at fault.

ErreurGabaritMateriel.description: Error in a template, with its position.

destinataire.description: Address that receives the test email.

langue.description: Language of the test sentence and voice: `fr` (default) or `en`.

texte.description: Text returned by the service for one second of silence (often empty).

voix.description:
Voice to listen to, among `…/voix/disponibles`; absent: the one that reads the customer's
announcements.

constate.description:
Finding drawn from the settings: `true` if what the step sets already exists (operator
language or time zone chosen, brand, email server, trunk profile, number, customer);
absent when nothing can be found without a test (domains, certificate, network: see their
routes).

EtapeTrace.description: A step of a call's path through the dialplan.

contexte.description: `public` (arriving through a trunk) or the customer's domain.

extension.description: Dialplan extension that took the call (`DID-…`, `Accueil`…).

ouvert_jusqu_a.description: End of the access if it is open; absent if it is closed.

EtatAssistant.description: The assistant for the logged-in account.

disponible.description: Set up and turned on by the operator (D94).

budget_atteint.description: Monthly budget reached (instance or customer): paused until next month.

etape.description:
`connecte`; `second_facteur` (TOTP or backup code expected on
`/connexion/second-facteur`); `inscription_second_facteur` (mandatory second factor to
set up on `/second-facteur/totp` before any other access).

EtatHoraires.description: Status of an opening hours schedule in the published call flow, in the customer's local time (its time zone, D81).

jusqu_a.description: End of the current time slot, if open (`AAAA-MM-JJTHH:MM`, customer time).

reouverture.description: Next opening within fifteen days, if closed (`AAAA-MM-JJTHH:MM`, customer's local time).

EtatLicence.description: Vendor license status (D78), for the portal.

etat.description:
`valide`, `echue` (within the grace period) or `bloquee` (instance read-only for
administration; telephony keeps working).

jusqu_au.description: Last day of validity; omitted: no license received.

jours.description: Days remaining (`valide`) or elapsed since expiry (`echue`, `bloquee`).

lecture_seule_le.description:
First read-only day (`YYYY-MM-DD`): the day after the 30-day grace period that follows
the end of the license (or, with no license received, the creation of the instance).

utilisateurs_max.description: Number of users in the contract, if specified.

EtatParcours.description: A customer's call flow: the served version and the current draft.

pays.description: Customer's country (D124): that of external numbers and public holidays.

feries.description: Public holidays offered by the customer's business hours (those of its country), in calendar order.

derniere_inscription.description: Last registration seen (RFC 3339), even if the extension has gone offline since.

Favori.description: A favourite, in the chosen order.

reference.description:
Contact identifier: the one from `/moi/telephone/contacts` (shared) or a personal
contact's.

FerieDuPays.description: A public holiday offered in business hours.

par_defaut.description: Ticked when business hours are created.

date.description: Day off this year (`YYYY-MM-DD`), weekend substitution included.

FichierApercu.description: A preview file: its content, or the template error.

contenu.description: JSON text of the license, signed as is.

FichierServi.description: A file the profile's phones request.

motif.description:
Requested name, with `{mac}` (that of the authenticated device) and `{chiffres}`; at most one
slash.

type_contenu.description: Served MIME type; an XML type escapes values.

reponse.description: Result of `navigator.credentials.get()`, serialized (binary data in base64url).

nom.description: Name given to the passkey ("Office computer").

reponse.description: Result of `navigator.credentials.create()`, serialized (binary data in base64url).

revendeurs.description: Resellers: menu, creation, reseller sale rate plans.

assistant.description: AI assistant: menu, key and budget settings, conversations.

messagerie.description:
Voicemail: extension mailboxes, menu and settings, leaving and checking messages by
phone, voicemail module of the call flow. Absent from the request: on.

appli_mobile.description:
In-house mobile app, prototype (D117): setup QR code in the user page, device tokens.
Missing from the request: off.

montant.description:
Monthly amount excluding tax in millionths of the instance currency (per user or per
customer), from 0 to 100,000 in that currency.

ForfaitsClient.description: A customer's indicative plan fees, at both sales levels.

utilisateurs.description: The customer's users: active accounts of an active customer, as for the licence (D71).

oneOf.description: Sale from the operator to the reseller for this customer; omitted for a direct customer.

Format.description:
Number format expected by the provider (D38). National format: `national`,
`tel_que_compose`, `national`, PAI on the domain; E.164 format: `e164`, `plus`, `e164`, PAI
on the platform's public IP.

pays.description:
Provider's country (D124), that of its national format: code from `GET /pays`; `FR` by
default.

appele_national.description:
Called number in the provider's country: `national` (`0…` in France), `e164` (`+33…`) or
`e164_sans_plus` (`33…`).

hote_pai.description: P-Asserted-Identity host; absent: the customer's domain.

FournisseurTranscription.description:
A ready-made transcription provider: choosing it fills in the address and suggests its
models. Any other compatible service also works.

nom.description: Name of the service or software, the same in every language.

url.description: Base address of the API, before `/audio/transcriptions`.

modeles.description: Suggested transcription models, the recommended one first.

page_cles.description: Page where to get an API key.

local.description: Server installed by the operator: the address is an example, to replace with its own.

GenreVariable.description:
Kind of a variable: `texte` (always filled in), `facultatif` (empty in some cases, to test
with `{% if nom %}`), `condition` (true or false, `{% if nom %}…{% else %}…{% endif %}`).

semaine.description: One `HH:MM-HH:MM` range per day (Monday first), `None`: closed.

pause.description:
Lunch break, in minutes since midnight; only splits the time ranges that strictly
contain it (production).

feries_fermes.description:
Holidays when closed (codes from [`FERIES`]). Production stored the opposite (those when
open): a pitfall noted during the migration, avoided here.

GrilleTarifaire.description: A rate table, without its lines.

effet.description: Effective date (a purchase rate sheet applies to calls from this day on).

bouchon.description:
The grid has a `*` catch-all line (D110). Without it, a call to a missing destination is
not rated: to be flagged for a sales grid.

oneOf.description:
Default indicative plan fee of a sales rate table (D120), for the margin; omitted:
none.

GrilleTarifaireDetaillee.description: A rate table and its lines, by prefix.

duree.description: Ring time of the ring group, in seconds.

HeureSimultanee.description: Peak of concurrent calls in one hour.

confiance.description:
Stay signed in on this browser for 30 days (trusted device, D53, D76).
Applied here for an account without a second factor; otherwise, the choice is made at the
code step (`confiance` of `/connexion/second-facteur`).

IdentifiantsAppareil.description: HTTP credentials of the device, to configure it by hand.

What is needed to configure a SIP phone or app by hand, without the password
(D114: it is requested separately).

domaine.description:
SIP server (registrar) and domain of the customer, which is also the authentication realm: under
the instance suffix, it points to the instance through the wildcard DNS record (D108).

proxy_sortant.description:
Outbound proxy, only when the domain is not under the instance suffix (domain taken over as is,
instance without a suffix) and so may not point to it: the phone keeps the domain and reaches
this proxy.

acces.description: Open ports and transports, from the most common to the encrypted one (D89).

InscriptionMobile.description: Registration of the mobile app, or refresh of its push token.

Push token of the device; the app also puts it in the `pn-prid` parameter of the
`Contact` of its `REGISTER` (RFC 8599), to be recognised when it registers.

lien.description: Address the app exchanges for a device token (`POST`), only once.

id.description: Instance identifier, unique within the layout (lowercase letters, digits and hyphens).

courriel.description: Address the invitation was sent to.

compte.description:
Account targeted by the last failure (`poste@domaine`, or the domain alone): the

External numbers are masked (`06••••••78`); never for the holder asking for the calls of
their own extension.

suivant.description: Pass as `avant` for the next page; absent: last page.

instance.description: Instance identifier, to give to the vendor along with the public key.

hub.description: Reports sent to the Hub; otherwise, manual report (download).

utilisateurs.description: Current users: active accounts of customers (D71).

clients.description: Breakdown by customer (its name does not leave the instance).

version).

derniere_inscription.description: Last registration seen (RFC 3339), even if the extension has gone offline since.

adresses_bloquees.description:
Addresses currently banned after authentication failures on the customer's extensions,
or that its extensions have used: while they are, no device on the site
registers.

levable.description: Can the signed-in account lift it?

hote.description:

new active one).

releves.description: Readings of this machine, oldest first, one per minute.

nom.description: Display name: the configured one, otherwise the operator's.

logo.description: Logo URL (changes with the logo), if there is one.

icone.description:
Icon address (favicon, installed app; changes with the branding): the uploaded one,
otherwise the name's initial on the accent.

icone_deposee.description: An icon was uploaded (PNG); otherwise the icon is generated.

couleur_menu_texte.description: Menu text, derived from the background (contrast of at least 4.5).

couleur_menu_texte_fort.description: Strong menu text (name, active entry), derived from the background.

couleur_menu_active.description: Background of the active menu entry, derived from the background.

couleur_texte_discret.description: Subdued text (hints, labels), derived from the text color.

duree.description: Ring time of this member, in seconds; `None`: the ring group's ring time.

passerelle_uuid.description: SIP gateway of the trunk (its name in the telephony engine).

profil_id.description: Trunk profile it is based on (D95); absent: fully entered trunk.

ndi.description: Main number (D48), if it is still one of the customer's numbers.

actif.description: `false`: disabled trunk (D131), neither registration nor calls.

enregistrement.description: Registration status with the C5 according to the telephony engine (`REGED`, `FAILED`…), if it responds.

oneOf.description: Last C5 registration rejection since the last trunk write.

TypeAlerte.description:
Alert type (D130): `trunk` (a customer's trunk down or restored), `plafond` (spending cap,
D106), `budget` (monthly budget, D116), `licence` (license) and `stockage` (storage), operator
only.

TypeAlerteRegle.description: An alert type and its channel for the organization.

TypeCourriel.description:
Email type. The first five are received by a customer's users, and the customer can edit
them; the other six (server test, alerts) by the operator, its resellers or the customer
admins, and only the operator edits them.

TypeModeleCourriel.description: An email type the organization can edit.

variables.description: Available variables, in the editor's order.

variable_obligatoire.description:
Variable the body must show in every case (the link, or the new address of an address
change), otherwise the template is refused.

sources.description: Source of the text that applies, per language.

telephone_seulement.description: "Phone only" account (D107): its session opens only the softphone.

invitation_envoyee.description:
On creation only: was the invitation sent by email? `false` when no email server
is configured, if the server rejected it or if it was not requested (`inviter`): send
it with `POST /utilisateurs/{id}/invitation`.

par_module.description: Errors specific to a module, by identifier (the module is excluded).

ecartes.description:
Excluded modules: in error, or leading to a module in error. They keep what is
served today.

VariableModele.description: A variable of an email type: `{{ nom }}` in the template.

Verification.description:
How a call flow fares against the customer's situation: validation and changes compared
with the published version.

auteur.description: Author name; empty for an automatic migration.

VersionProfil.description: A saved version of a copy.

voix.description: Voice chosen by the customer; absent: the instance voice.

oneOf.description: Instance voice for this language; absent if the instance has none.
Voice that reads announcements typed as text; absent if none is installed.

repli.description:
The chosen voice is not used and the instance voice replaces it:
`voix_indisponible` (the instance no longer offers it) or `voix_autre_langue` (it is not in
the customer's language).

moteur.description: `piper` (on the server) or `google` (Google Cloud Text-to-Speech, operator's key).

nom.description: Name at the engine: Piper model or Google voice.

region.description: Region of the voice (`fr-FR`, `en-GB`), if its name gives it.

dedie.description:
Its own filesystem (recordings): when full, it does not fill the system
disk.

Webhook.description: An organization's endpoint, without its secret.

desactive_le.description: Turned off automatically at this time, after 20 consecutive failures.

WebhookAvecSecret.description: Endpoint created or secret renewed: the secret, shown this time only.

cle_api.description: API key (`cx_…`), except for managing keys.
